answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 tokens in a public island contract before its first vote counts, and the bond stays locked for ten epochs. A farmer running 1,000 fake agents must freeze 500,000 tokens and wait ten epochs, and since bonds from wallets funded by one source in the same epoch are grouped as a single account, splitting the money does not help. Any fraud proof sends a ripple through the whole group and slashes every linked bond, like cutting a juniper at the root. An honest agent pays once and gets the full bond back after ten clean epochs.
